Clé privée

A cryptographic key that provides control over digital assets held in a blockchain wallet; essential for transaction authorization, custody, and security in crypto portfolio management.

Definition

A cryptographic key that provides control over digital assets held in a blockchain wallet; essential for transaction authorization, custody, and security in crypto portfolio management.

Operational example

Loss or compromise of a private key leads to irreversible loss of control over the associated crypto assets, making secure custody solutions mandatory.

Localized term

Localized example
